binding_corrections: RF80 power bits explicitly PWR0/PWR1: 00 Sprint, 10 extended, 01 full, 11 invalid. Older audit bit-order wording is ambiguous; native decode is authoritative.
RF2M MODULE_ID resistors 18.2k BOOST2S / 39.2k BUCK4S / 82k TRAIN_ONLY replace obsolete R0 10k/22k/47k contract.
RF2M FAULT_N is push-pull VALID_ARM, high after accepted arm; RF80 FAULT_N open-drain, low when unarmed.
RF80 I2C branch must be disconnected while armed, including RTC accesses.

RF2M native SRC_ON = PREPARE & SAFE_N & MUTE_N; CONV_EN = SRC_ON & PA_PREPARE. Source programming therefore requires released MUTE_N while ARM/SLOT/KEY remain low. PA_PREPARE is a distinct converter-precharge permission.
